name: Logo Generator
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Turn a brand name, industry and style brief into AI logo concepts with ManyMotions (formerly ClipWave). Logo Maker prepares the logo prompt and settings, generates up to four concepts per request in your connected ManyMotions account (GPT Image 2 by default, other image models available), lets you check the job status in chat and opens the result in the Media Forge Logo tab to refine, re-run or download. Generating uses credits in your existing ManyMotions account. Outputs are AI-generated raster PNG images; editable vector files and trademark clearance are not included.
summary_ja: ブランド情報からロゴ案を生成し、ManyMotions上で調整する。
limitations_ja: ManyMotionsアカウントとクレジットが必要。出力はPNGでベクターと商標調査は含まれない。B12の同名掲載とは別。
